claim: Windows release candidate; production certification requires measured evidence

gates.requirement: No reproducible critical crash in the documented release workflow corpus
All save/reopen, recovery, backup and interrupted-write regression cases pass
Physical common-stroke latency p95 < 20 ms on identified reference hardware
Sustained >=24 FPS for specified representative moving scenes on reference hardware
All reference image/video/audio and range-sync cases pass
Eight-hour engine AND desktop stress runs without sustained unexplained memory growth
Restoration verified for every supported mutation family
Pressure, pen/touch separation, palm rejection and interruption tested on physical supported tablets/drivers
Transaction validation, stale-revision rollback, confinement and cancellation cases pass
All advertised complete locales pass string coverage, layout and native-language review
Release executable and installer signatures validate for the exact binary hashes
Clean install, upgrade and uninstall pass on a clean supported Windows VM while user projects/preferences remain intact
Two clean pinned builds have matching unsigned payload hashes, or documented nondeterminism is resolved

notes: Headless MCP latency is not physical drawing latency. A short stress smoke does not satisfy eight hours. A compiled installer script is not an installation test. Signing credentials and physical Apple/tablet access are not present in this workspace.
